title: A full 3D AI game created in two days
author: Delicious-Shower8401

comments.author: Necessary-Ad2110
comments.body: This is impressive, could you detail your development journey? How difficult or easy as AI with certain tasks and how much of the project did you end up manually coding or reviewing yourself? I am guessing every asset in the game is also AI?

replies.author: Delicious-Shower8401
replies.body: I will try to answer briefly and to the point. The part that AI handled perfectly and required minimal editing was the 3D part and related elements (rigging, animation, texture). The most difficult part was the code and logic. That's where we had to sweat it out.
